title: Older BAE archives colleague with TS/SCI warned him

tellings.quote: one of the older guys who uh worked for archives had a TSSCI and made his way to the intelligence community as a government employee.

plain: Dylan Borland, a former worker at the defence contractor BAE who now speaks as a whistleblower, says an older colleague in BAE's archives warned him about something. Borland tells Michels the man held a TS/SCI clearance, the top-secret level that also opens tightly restricted programmes, and later moved into the intelligence agencies as a government employee. What the warning said, the telling does not give.
